question: Which month of 2025 had our highest invoiced revenue in TZS, and list the invoices from that month.
reason: CQ1 on GPT-6 Luna after the luna6-planner merge (RAG 5d18a4cc). The prompt says the question's own words win, so the planner answered unsupported needs_prior_answer (the invoice list needs the month first) and the coordinator finished with an explanation instead of asking for the month on its own. Expected from the independent oracle: 2025-12, TZS 244,965,526.15, 118 invoices.
